items.title: Power Plant and Fuel System: N1, N2 and TOT
items.description: The Arriel 2D engine's own vocabulary, the FADEC's automatic starting and overspeed-shutdown behaviour, the back-up governor, and the fuel path from tank to injector.

items.title: VEMD, FLI and the Performance Page
items.description: The duplex VEMD's three operating modes, how the FLI tracks N1, TOT and torque, and the weight-entry page that also drives the LIMIT light's accuracy.

items.title: Main Gearbox and Drive System: One Number, Whole Drivetrain
items.description: The engine-to-MGB coupling, the Starflex main rotor and see-saw tail rotor, and the reference speed, aural warnings, glide figures and rotor brake numbers that follow from it.

items.title: Hydraulic System: One Pump, One Circuit
items.description: The single-circuit hydraulic system, the LIMIT light and its link to the Performance page's weight entry, and the real failure procedure down to the landing technique.

items.title: Electrical Power Systems: The Starter Generator Choice
items.description: The DC network and Electrical Master Box, the standard-versus-optional starter generator and what it changes, the optional AC system, and why total failure costs you the AFCS for good.
